scientific_integrity: Analytic arbitrary-degree proof and standalone algebraic/numeric consistency tests are supplied. The finite tests are not a substitute for infinite-degree proof. No external independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The sharp frontier is the ambient holomorphic Jacobian Euclidean operator norm at an exact regular-polygon configuration. It is not a finite-perturbation Lipschitz guarantee, a global convergence theorem for general configurations, or a floating-point error bound. Historical priority outside inspected literature remains qualified.
title: Sharp Fourier-mode stability frontier for regular-polygon Ehrlich–Aberth iterates
